description: Delete a draft, and with it each of its files that no other draft uses. Refused with 409 while one of its posts is queued or not yet confirmed. Posts already made stay in the history.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

title: Delete a draft
